d:
This is the final chapter of Corrupted Demon Family, one of EverForever’s most iconic series. It was originally released in mid-2023, but the version currently available on this site is still incomplete, with only 175 pages. I am uploading the complete version both to restore the missing content and to preserve the work as it was originally intended.
EverForever later deleted his main Pixiv account, and his other accounts can no longer be found. Archived posts suggest that his Pixiv account may have been suspended for prohibited content, but it remains unclear what happened to him afterward.
It is sad to see such a distinctive creator disappear. Corrupted Demon Family has always been one of my favorite works of his, and this upload is also a small tribute to his creative legacy. I hope his work may one day resurface.

这是 EverForever 《Corrupted Demon Family》的终章。该作品最早发布于 2023 年年中，目前网站内的版本仍只有 175 页，内容并不完整，因此决定将手中保存的完整内容上传。
EverForever 后来注销了自己的 Pixiv 主账号，其他平台上的相关账号目前也已无法搜索到。没有人知道他在 2023 年底之后究竟经历了什么。根据存档页面中保留的信息，他曾在 Patreon 最后的几篇帖子中提到，自己的 Pixiv 账号似乎因涉及平台禁止发布的内容而被封禁。
很遗憾，这样一位富有个人风格的创作者就此从公众视野中消失。此次上传完整版，也算是对这部作品、这个系列，以及他创作生涯的一份纪念。希望未来仍有机会再次看到他的作品。
n: [Misc] EverForever - Corrupted Demon Family 3 (200p Complete Story )
